tools.name: grades.scale
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what a grade or level means, or for the whole grading scale, in WASSCE, Ghana's BECE, Kenya's KCSE or South Africa's NSC (for example "is C6 a credit?" or "what is level 4 in matric?"). Do not use it to work out an aggregate or mean grade: use the examination's own tool.
